description: Source notes for the reviewed station-stop mappings in overrides/italy-uic-crosswalks.csv.

regione_lombardia_stops.coordinate_encoding: Decimal digits without separators; latitude decimal follows the first two digits and longitude decimal follows the first digit. Raw and normalized values are retained per row.

otd_uic_stops.selected_record_granularity: GTFS location_type 0 stop record with a numeric UIC stop_id. The separate Parent{UIC} record has location_type 1 and is not the mapped call identity. Quay/platform records are not mapped.

oebb_hafas_rj83.occurrence: RJ 83 from the exact Trento-board acquisition
oebb_hafas_rj83.selected_record_granularity: type S station-stop records. Each accepted UIC alias is a literal U× value in the same record's gidL; platform and parent records are not inferred.
oebb_hafas_rj83.coordinate_encoding: crd.x is longitude and crd.y is latitude in integer microdegrees; recorded coordinates are normalized from those exact values.

wikidata_bologna_station_identity_bridge.property_references: No per-property references are attached to these identifier claims. The finite mapping is retained only with the exact official RFI record, literal HAFAS UIC alias, competing Bologna Centrale AV identity, and captured same-date RJ83 occurrence; this entity is not used as an automatic matcher.

dated_occurrence.source: Captured SBB Formation occurrence 25574 and exact RFI/ViaggiaTreno occurrence

rj83_occurrence.source: Exact RFI/ViaggiaTreno RJ 83 occurrence paired to the same-date ÖBB HAFAS RJ 83 journey
rj83_occurrence.decision: Finite reviewed STOP identities only; no platform equivalence, suffix arithmetic, automatic name matching, or distance threshold. The Bologna RFI/UIC bridge is explicitly third-party and uncited at the individual-property level; it is corroborated by the official provider records, the distinct Bologna Centrale AV record, and the exact dated occurrence.

rfi_sbb_ec46_20261108.publisher: RFI station register; SBB Formation; Wikidata identifier bridge
rfi_sbb_ec46_20261108.identity_rule: Official RFI page iframe placeId plus reviewed RFI catalogue VT ID; exact page identifier P12206 and UIC P722 on the same entity; literal UIC in native SBB Formation. No name/coordinate matching or UIC suffix arithmetic.
rfi_sbb_ec46_20261108.limitation: Wikidata individual claims may be uncited; the finite mapping is independently corroborated by exact official RFI page identifiers, the retained same-date native route and existing VT catalogue. This is a manually reviewed mapping, never an automatic entity/name matcher.
